verdict.rationale: Orb documents an Ingest Usage Events endpoint, per-event idempotency that prevents duplicates within the account grace period, and high-volume ingestion of 1M+ events per second. Backdating is covered by event backfills plus late-data handling that automatically recalculates affected invoices. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of throughput, idempotency, and backfill behavior (all evidence is vendor docs).
